Class Role

java.lang.Object
org.roux.model.Role
public final class Role extends Object
The Role type holds the byte stored for who sent a message. The NONE byte is 0. The SYSTEM byte is 1. The USER byte is 2. The ASSISTANT byte is 3. The TOOL byte is 4. The TOOL_CALL byte is 5. nameOf(byte) turns a byte into the word written beside the message text. fromName(String) turns that word back into a byte. The type refuses construction. // @aa-sdd L40 aa-sdd-source-prose.md#Role roux-design.md

  • Method Details

    • nameOf

      public static String nameOf(byte code)
      The method returns the word for a role byte. The word system matches SYSTEM. The word user matches USER. The word assistant matches ASSISTANT. The word tool matches TOOL. The word tool_call matches TOOL_CALL. Any other byte returns the word none.
      Parameters:
      code - The code is the role byte from a frame or an index row.
      Returns:
      The word is the text stored with the message.

    • fromName

      public static byte fromName(String name)
      The method returns the role byte for a word. A null word returns NONE. The word system returns SYSTEM. The word user returns USER. The word assistant returns ASSISTANT. The word tool returns TOOL. The word tool_call returns TOOL_CALL. Any other word returns NONE.
      Parameters:
      name - The name is the role word, or null.
      Returns:
      The byte is the matching role, or NONE.
